thread:
jordan: Quick kickoff — creating a lightweight "SI Launch Concierge" for partners: single-package with marketplace checklist, HW compatibility matrix, co-marketing assets, and a staged announcement plan. Need input on who owns which piece.
leah: Love the concierge idea. Can we make two tracks: "marketplace-first" (self-serve listing + badge) and "pilot-first" (early access + joint press)? Different collateral.
mohit: Agree. For HW matrix: I'll pull compatibility from infra team and map recommended SKUs and minimum drivers. Also flag bundles eligible for loaner program.
agnes: On content: we should include a one-pager for sales (value props + pricing model), a runbook for SEs (play-by-play deploy), and a preflight checklist for partners. Short videos (3-5min) will help adoption.
jordan: Good. For timeline: aim to pilot concierge with 5 SIs in three weeks, GA two weeks after pilot. Need to coordinate legal, marketing, and marketplace release window.
kate: For co-marketing: propose a three-stage cadence: 1) announcement blog + partner quote; 2) joint webinar/demo 4 weeks after; 3) customer case study 8-12 weeks. Legal needs 2-week review for partner logos and quotes.
leah: Marketplace gating: require "si_profile" + "cert_level" fields and a checkbox "approved_for_listing". Only Bronze+ will show publically. Also add an "is_hw_loan_eligible" flag.
mohit: Loaner program constraints: 2-week max, partners pay shipping & insurance, require form-signed SLA. I'll draft the shipping flow and include warehouse contacts.
agness: Typo: agnes :)
agnes: noted :sweat_smile: Also need telemetry keys in the marketplace listing: partner_id, cert_level, launch_concierge_version. Ops wants that for billing and referral credits.
jordan: Co-marketing asset list: logo pack, one-pager, webinar slide deck, demo script, 2 short vids. Marketing to create templates; partner fills out 3 questions for quote: impact metric, contact, brief blurb.
kate: We'll need a partner communications calendar. Marketing can own content; Partnerships will own outreach and SE scheduling. Legal: I'll ping for approvals.
mohit: On integrations: include a short checklist for connectors (KMS integration, VPC peering, monitoring hooks). Sample commands to validate connectivity:```bash
# validate peering
ping -c 3 <private-gateway>
# validate KMS access
aws kms list-keys --profile partner-role
```
leah: Action items: Jordan - draft concierge doc + pilot list; Mohit - HW matrix & loaner flow; Agnes - SE runbook + videos outline; Kate - marketing calendar & legal ping. Ops-bot create card?
ops-bot: Card created: https://redwood.atlassian.net/browse/REDWOOD-SI-3000 "SI Launch Concierge: pilot and co-marketing". Deadlines set: pilot start in 3 weeks.
jordan: I'll assemble assets and share Confluence link by EOD tomorrow. One more ask: track partner preference for joint announcements (co-announcement, press release, blog only). Add to intake form.
kate: We'll add that field and a sample PR timeline. Also prepare an embargo window option for sensitive releases.
agnes: Suggestion: include a small "early wins" checklist partners can complete in 48h: marketplace listing, basic deploy, and first eval run. Helps momentum.
mohit: I'll add quick test scripts for first-eval run.
jordan: Great meeting. We'll checkpoint next Tue. Thanks all. :v:
